Our Story

About Caspian Bridge

Who We Are

A Trusted Commercial Bridge

Caspian Bridge International Ltd is a United Kingdom registered private limited company providing international trading, procurement, contract manufacturing and business consultancy services. We are formally registered in England & Wales and operate in full compliance with UK export controls, HMRC regulations and applicable international trade law.

Our mission is to create reliable, transparent and commercially efficient bridges between manufacturers, suppliers and buyers across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and worldwide — reducing complexity, managing risk and creating lasting value for all parties.

We operate across four core sectors — Energy & Petrochemicals, Industrial Equipment, Agriculture & Livestock, and Consumer Products — combining deep sector knowledge, an extensive verified supplier network and rigorous commercial standards in every engagement.

As a UK-registered entity, we bring full legal credibility under English law to every transaction — giving international counterparties the confidence that all agreements are clear, enforceable and conducted to the highest professional standards.

Whether acting as principal trader, procurement partner, commercial agent or market entry adviser, Caspian Bridge delivers results — connecting the right suppliers with the right buyers, on the right terms, every time.

Foundation

Vision, Mission & Values

🌐
Vision
To become one of the most trusted international trading and procurement partners in the world — known for integrity, transparency and commercial excellence.

We aim to be the gateway of choice connecting emerging and established markets across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and beyond — through a reliable, UK-registered commercial platform that creates lasting value for every party in every transaction.
🎯
Mission
To deliver transparent, efficient and commercially sound solutions for global trade and procurement — reducing complexity at every stage and mitigating commercial and regulatory risk.

We are committed to creating measurable, lasting value for every client, supplier and business partner we work with — and to building relationships that endure beyond individual transactions.
⚖
Values
Integrity — Every engagement conducted with absolute honesty.
Transparency — All fees and terms disclosed upfront, always.
Reliability — We deliver on our commitments, every time.
Partnership — Long-term relationships, not transactions.
Excellence — The highest commercial and compliance standards.

Our Sectors

Industries We Trade & Source

Our Sectors

Four Industries. One Trusted Partner.

Caspian Bridge operates across four core sectors with active supplier relationships, verified trading routes and deep product knowledge in each. Every transaction is conducted under formal written agreement with full compliance and documentation as standard.

Energy & Petrochemicals
⛩

Energy & Petrochemicals

We source, trade and broker petroleum products and petrochemical feedstocks for refineries, blending companies, distributors and industrial buyers worldwide. Our supplier network spans the CIS, the Persian Gulf, Eastern Europe and Asia — giving our clients access to competitive, verified sources with full quality certification, independent inspection and compliance documentation as standard.

We handle all aspects of the transaction — from initial sourcing and price negotiation through to shipping documentation, customs clearance and final delivery under CIF, FOB or DAP terms.

Urea 46% N Sulphur Granular/Lumpy Base Oil SN150/SN500 Petroleum Coke Bitumen
🏭

Industrial Equipment

We procure and supply specialised industrial machinery, plant equipment and technical components for petrochemical plants, manufacturing facilities, construction projects and infrastructure developments across the Middle East and Asia. Our engineering procurement capability covers both new equipment and certified used machinery from leading European and global manufacturers.

We evaluate suppliers on technical specification, certification, lead time and commercial terms — ensuring every piece of equipment delivered meets the buyer's exact requirements and applicable international standards including ATEX, CE and ISO.

Process Equipment Pumps & Valves ATEX Heat Exchangers Heavy Machinery Control & Instrumentation
Industrial Equipment
Agriculture & Livestock
🌾

Agriculture & Livestock

We trade and source agricultural commodities, farming inputs and livestock nutrition products for wholesale buyers across the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Our agricultural trading capability covers staple food commodities, industrial crops, fertilisers and specialist animal feed — all sourced from verified producers with full phytosanitary certification and quality documentation.

We work with buyers to match product specifications, manage origin requirements and coordinate bulk shipping under standard international trade terms including CIF, CFR and FOB.

Wheat & Barley Sugar ICUMSA 45 Fertilisers NPK/DAP Sunflower & Palm Oil Animal Feed
🛍

Consumer Products

We facilitate the international trading of branded and generic consumer goods — connecting European and global manufacturers with wholesale distributors and buyers across the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Our consumer products capability covers fast-moving consumer goods, personal care, food & beverage and health & wellness categories, including both established brands and private label manufacturing.

We also engage in contract manufacturing and private label production — working with certified manufacturers to produce goods under client specifications for distribution under their own brand or our commercial arrangements.

FMCG Personal Care Food & Beverage Health & Wellness Private Label
Consumer Products

The Difference

Six Reasons Clients Choose Us

Every engagement with Caspian Bridge is governed by a formal written agreement, conducted with full transparency and backed by the credibility of a UK-registered company.

🏛
01
UK Registered Company
Full legal credibility under English law — every counterparty knows the framework is clear, enforceable and internationally respected. Our UK registration provides clients with a stable, transparent legal foundation that underpins every commercial agreement we enter into, regardless of where the transaction takes place.

02
Global Supplier Network
Active, verified relationships with manufacturers and suppliers across Europe, the CIS, the Gulf and Asia — built through real commercial transactions, not directories. Our network gives clients access to competitive pricing, reliable supply and pre-vetted counterparties that have already been assessed for quality, compliance and commercial reliability.

03
Multi-Market Experience
Deep understanding of commercial, regulatory and cultural dynamics in every market we serve — from EU export controls and UK sanctions compliance to Gulf commercial practices and Asian logistics. We anticipate challenges before they arise and navigate complexity so our clients don't have to.

04
Professional Procurement
Sector expertise across all four active industries — evaluating suppliers on technical specification, commercial terms, certification and compliance criteria, not just price. 05
Long-Term Partnerships
We invest in understanding each client's business deeply — their products, markets, constraints and objectives — so that we can provide increasing value over time. We are a long-term commercial partner, not a transactional intermediary. The relationships we build are designed to last and to grow as our clients' businesses grow.

Transparent Practices
Every engagement is governed by a formal written agreement with all fees, terms and processes disclosed upfront. No hidden charges, no surprises, no ambiguity.
